# Linux chmod builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/chmod-builder/

Build owner, group and other permissions with read, write and execute/search bits and optional special mode bits.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Choose owner read/write, group read and other read to produce mode 644.

## Limits and checks

Directory execute means search/traversal. Special bits have context-specific effects; this tool explains the mode but does not change any filesystem permissions.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
